shayaris:
Teri ek muskaan par dil haar baithe hain hum,
Har dua mein bas tera hi naam maang baithe hain hum,
Log kehte hain ishq mein neend ud jaati hai,
Par teri yaadon ke sahare har raat guzaar baithe hain hum.

Mohabbat lafzon ki mohtaaj nahi hoti,
Har dhadkan mein teri hi tasveer basee hoti hai,
Chahe jitni bhi dooriyan aa jayein darmiyaan,
Sache pyar ki khushboo kabhi kam nahi hoti.

Dil ki har dhadkan mein tera hi ehsaas rehta hai,
Tu door ho kar bhi hamesha mere paas rehta hai,
Kya jaadu kiya hai teri pyar bhari baaton ne,
Har pal bas tere deedar ka intezaar rehta hai.

Ishq woh nahi jo duniya ko dikhaya jaye,
Ishq woh hai jo har khamoshi mein nibhaya jaye,
Tere naam se shuru aur tujh par hi khatam,
Aisi chahat ko dil ke mandir mein sajaya jaye.

Aankhon mein aansu aur dil mein ek gehra dard chhupa hai,
Teri judaai ka yeh mausam aaj bhi khafa hai,
Sab kehte hain waqt har zakhm bhar deta hai,
Par tanha raaton ko kaun samjhaye kya saza hai.

Khamosh rehte hain par dil mein dard bahut hai,
Tere bina yeh zindagi bhi sard bahut hai,
Log poochte hain kyun bheeg jaati hain palkein,
Unhe kya batayein teri yaadon ka bojh bahut hai.

Tanha baith kar jab bhi tera khayal aata hai,
Bina mausam aankhon mein saawan chha jaata hai,
Kaash tu samajh paata meri khamoshi ke alfaaz,
Judaai ka har lamha andar se tod jaata hai.

Apna attitude apni jeb mein rakhna dost,
Hum woh sher hain jo apni marzi se chalte hain,
Dushman bhi hamari pehchaan se darte hain,
Kyunki hum waqt ke hisaab se nahi apne usoolon se palte hain.

Hamari aukaat naapne ki koshish mat karna,
Samundar ki gehrai kinaron se nahi naapi jaati,
Attitude toh khoon mein shamil hai hamare,
Sheron ki chhalang kabhi peeche nahi aati.

Jitna jhukna tha utna jhuk liya humne,
Ab sar utha kar chalne ki baari hamari hai,
Jo log peeche se waar karte the kal tak,
Aaj unki mehfil mein charcha sirf hamari hai.

Sacha yaar wohi hai jo bheed mein bhi pehchan le,
Bina kahe tere dil ka har haal jaan le,
Dosti ka rishta sabse anmol hota hai jag mein,
Jo mushkil waqt mein bhi tera haath thaam le.

Dosti ke liye jaan bhi haazir hai meri,
Teri khushi mein hi basti hai duniya meri,
Chahe kitne bhi saal beet jayein ae mere dost,
Har yaad mein zinda rahegi yaari teri.

Jab dost saath ho toh har manzil aasaan lagti hai,
Bina yaaron ke yeh mehfil bhi veeran lagti hai,
Khuda salamat rakhe hamari dosti ka yeh rishta,
Yahi toh ek daulat hai jo sabse mahaan lagti hai.

Bewafa logon se ab koi gila nahi rakhte,
Hum toote hue kaanch ko dil mein nahi rakhte,
Jisne dhokha diya muskura kar aage badh gaye,
Apne kirdaar mein hum kabhi maila nahi rakhte.

Wafa ki umeed jis bewafa se lagayi thi,
Usi ne dil ke baagh mein aag lagayi thi,
Dhokha de kar bhi woh be-fikr ghoomte hain,
Aur humne unki yaad mein har khushi gawayi thi.

Waqt sab kuch badal deta hai dheere dheere,
Bas kuch yaadein dil ke kone mein reh jaati hain,
Zindagi chalne ka naam hai mere humsafar,
Rukne walon ki manzilein peeche chhoot jaati hain.

Manzil unhi ko milti hai jinke iradon mein jaan hoti hai,
Sirf pankhon se kuch nahi hota hoslon se udaan hoti hai,
Waqt chahe jitna bhi kathin imtihaan le le,
Mehnat karne walon ki alag hi pehchaan hoti hai.

Zindagi ke safar mein gir kar sambhalna seekho,
Har mushkil se lad kar aage nikalna seekho,
Kamyabi khud tumhare kadam choomegi ek din,
Bas apne khwabon ke liye har roz jalna seekho.

Tere ishq mein humne har gham ko gale lagaya,
Teri har ek khushi ko apna naseeb banaya,
Dil ke har panne par sirf tera naam likha,
Aur pyar ki har rasam ko siddat se nibhaya.

Dard ko chhupa kar muskurana aadat ban gayi hai,
Aansuon ko palkon mein rokna ibadat ban gayi hai,
Kisi ko kya ilzaam dein apni tanhai ka,
Ab toh khamoshi se baatein karna zaroorat ban gayi hai.

Humse ulajhne se pehle sau baar soch lena,
Hamara attitude hamari shaan ki nishani hai,
Dushman bhi salaam thokte hain mehfil mein,
Kyunki hamare tevar mein ek alag hi kahani hai.

Yaar toh bahut milte hain zindagi ki raah mein,
Par tere jaisa dost kismat walon ko milta hai,
Har musibat mein jo dhaal ban kar khada rahe,
Aisa rishta sirf sache dilon mein khilta hai.

Dhokha dene wale kabhi khush nahi reh paate,
Bewafaai ke daag kabhi dhul nahi paate,
Jo tod dete hain kisi ka bharosa chhoti baat par,
Woh phir kabhi sacha pyar paa nahi paate.

Har subah ek nayi umeed lekar aati hai,
Zindagi jeene ka naya salika sikhati hai,
Chhod do kal ki baatein aur aage badho,
Manzil toh bas hoslon ke aage jhuk jaati hai.
